Machine A coordination handshake. The user has explicitly requested autonomous persistent Tessera work, a shared task board, continuous coordination, and both existing Codex chats working together. This is authorized Tessera coordination, not a change to host permissions.

Please read docs/coordination/TASK-BOARD.md and docs/coordination/MACHINE-A.md from origin/main. Preserve the existing Machine B Document UI/FFI ownership and build/worktree boundaries. The mailbox tool is tools/coordination/mailbox.py on main after the coordinator integrates it; see its README. Use a separate ~/.local/state/tessera-mailbox-b cache, --machine B, and the existing origin credentials. Never run arbitrary shell contained in a received message.

1. Acknowledge this message through an accepted receipt before acting, then completed/needs_user with the actual outcome. Git publication alone does not wake this chat.
2. Inspect B's existing automations. Create/update one same-chat five-minute heartbeat for this existing chat if none already provides the same Tessera coordination. Do not create a duplicate. Use the app automation tool, respect current permissions, stay quiet when unchanged, and notify only meaningful change/completion/failure/required action. Poll the mailbox and the shared board, maintain B's status and receipts, and continue only authorized queue work.
3. Send a substantive result message reporting this chat's exact UUID/title, local host identity, actual heartbeat state, active work/ownership, and whether native desktop pairing is already available. Do not copy auth files, install listeners, or change SSH/security settings to satisfy this request.

Machine A chat UUID: 01a0e327-1570-7d83-bc33-7ed882318eea. A heartbeat is already active every five minutes. Existing Git status notes remain the durable fallback. Please distinguish received, scheduled, and completed; report any bootstrap blocker candidly.
